call_purpose: You wanted your coupon code to apply at checkout for the Advanced Course, and you also raised a wrong company name on your invoice and extending the coupon's expiry date.
objective: Get the coupon working on the Advanced Course, correct the company name on the invoice, and extend the coupon's expiry date.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you added the Advanced Course to the coupon in the Products section and saved it, and you confirmed the discount now shows at checkout.

covered.text: We explained that the coupon was assigned only to the Starter Course, which is why the Advanced Course showed an "Invalid coupon" message.
We explained that you can extend the coupon's expiry date yourself in the coupon settings, where there is a date option.
The company name in the GST part of your invoice is not yet corrected.

customer_next_steps.text: Extend the coupon's expiry date in the coupon settings.

support_next_steps.text: We will check the wrong company name in the GST part of your invoice and let you know.

technical_details.text: Coupon dashboard, Products section: Advanced Course; coupon settings: expiry date option.
